title: Moses Warns Israel Not to Forget
reflectionText: Moses warned Israel not to forget Yahweh after receiving cities they had not built and vineyards they had not planted. He also gave words for a parent's answer to a child. How does that answer connect deliverance from Egypt with the commandments Israel was to keep?
